title: Research alongside the start-up phase of the project "Inclusive Employment within the Social Community"
summary:
About every second person with a severe mental illness who is supported in outpatient assisted living is without any day structure offers, employment or work. This significantly limits these people´s chances of full and effective participation.

In the project BiSi ("Inclusive Employment within the Social Community"), inclusive, needs-based and resource-oriented employment opportunities are to be created in the social space for this target group and made available to those affected who wish to do so, without a preceding training phase and thus at al low threshold. In addition, accompanying professional support in employment is ensured, which both employees and employment providers can take advantage of, with which the project follows the evidence-based rehabilitation paradigm "first place, than train". This approach has already been tested in the BiSi model project and will now transition from a model project to standard care as part of a start-up phase (BiSi-2). 

The trail of the BiSi-2 project is being scientifically monitored and evaluated, with the research focus on comparing a group of participants with the BiSi program versus a group without the BiSi program.
conditions: Diagnosis-independent: All psychiatric diagnoses according to ICD-10, except delirium, dementia and acute intoxication.

interventions.name: BiSi-Group: People with severe mental illness who use assistance services for self-determined and independent coping with everyday life in the form outpatient assisted living (or, in individual cases, also inpatient), are not employed and are not pursuing any other regular work, employment or educat

Control group: People without interest in an innovative employment program and who have agreed to a scientific progress survey. The control group  remains in regular care. 
The surveys for the project evaluation will be conducted by means of questionnaires and interviews (see "outcomes").

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Persons:
-with mental disabilities according to § 2 para. 2 SGB IX
-wo make use of assistance services in accordance with § 78 SGB IX for self-determined and independent management of everyday life in the form of outpatient (or in individual cases inpatient) assisted living 
-who are not gainfully employed and are not engaged in any other regular work, employment or educational activity

Additional criteria:
-age over 18
-currently without employment in the general labor market (full- or part-time, mini-job)
-currently not in sheltered employment or day structuring measures (without visiting a contact point) or participating in education or training measures
-currently incapacitated for work or not considered employable on the general labor market
-rejecting placement in a worksop for disabled people, a day structure/work therapy measure or a day care center so far
-interested in participating in an innovative employment project (BiSi-2) and the associated scientific evaluation study
Exclusion criteria:
no intoxication, no delirium, no dementia syndrome
